inline_rules.branch:
After the prefix, the ticket reference then a kebab-case slug: `<prefix>/<ticket>-<slug>`.
Example: `docs/03-forgejo-issue-tracker`.
inline_rules.commit:
Conventional Commits, subject line only: `type: short description`.
No body, no trailers, no scope brackets.
inline_rules.pr:
Title: `<type>: <short description> (#<issue>)`, e.g. `docs: move issue tracker to Forgejo (#3)`, so GitHub links the issue.
Body includes `Closes #<issue>` so the PR is linked to and closes its issue.
Assignee: the author.
Labels: one label matching the PR's type (feat, fix, docs, …).
Review: none required.
Merge strategy: merge commit.
